label: Lowered after unrewarded/a1-S2 trials and a1 choices; drops amplify late in episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (1 + np.clip((ep_trial - 70) / 30, 0, 1) * 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_state == 1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 2 sits near 0.93-0.97 and dips with history; timing alone R^2 0.43 (it falls strongly in the last ~20 trials of the episode). Beyond timing, observed-only: at D1 it is lowered by an unrewarded previous trial (-0.03) and most by a previous a1->S2 (rare) unrewarded trial (extra -0.07), also lowered after a1 S2 rewarded (-0.05), and raised after a2->S1 (rare) trials (+0.03). At GO it is lowered after choosing a1 last trial and further after a rewarded S1 trial. At D2 it is lower when the agent just chose a1 (-0.03) and lower the more the ideal observer believes S1 is good (belief_lo, negative weight). All these history effects scale up roughly 3x over episode trials 70-99 (multiplier 1 + 2*clip((t-70)/30)), matching the late-episode collapse of the gate. Not driven by this trial's future reward. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.694, test 0.694 vs ceilings all 0.75 / all observed 0.72; an earlier model-output (policy) explanation is not needed: observed history + belief reach ~96% of the observed ceiling.

issues: Scores reproduce: the claimed 8 terms score test R^2 beyond timing 0.694 (timing alone 0.431). That is close to the all-observed ceiling of 0.72. The misses output shows no large systematic class: the largest mean error in any phase x previous-trial cell is +0.026 (D2 after a1 S2 r), and the phase means are within +/-0.004.

The label overstates how much the effects grow late in the episode. A multiplier of 1+2*clip((t-70)/30) (about 3x) is not the best fit. With the multiplier on all terms, about 2x (1+clip((t-70)/30)) gives test 0.713 vs 0.700 for 3x, and 4x gives 0.665. The late amplification is real, though: removing the multiplier drops test to 0.653.
The explanation says 'All of these history effects grow about 3x', but two terms (D1 a1-S2-r and D1 a2->S1) have no multiplier. Putting the multiplier on them too raises test slightly (0.700).

The D1 lowering after a1->S2 applies whether or not the trial was rewarded (residual a1 S2 r -0.036, a1 S2 u -0.127). This is consistent with the terms but is really a 'previous trial reached S2 via a1 (rare)' effect plus a reward effect, rather than a specifically 'unrewarded' story.
The belief_lo term at D2 adds about 0.03 (test 0.664 without it). Belief gradients also show up at D1 and GO in the profile, but adding a belief term for those phases did not help (0.681).
The D2 effect of choosing a1 is strongest when it led to S2 (residual -0.070 vs -0.028 for a1->S1). Adding a D2 a1&S2 term helps slightly (better terms below).
skeptic.revised_label: Lowered after unrewarded and a1->S2 (rare) trials and after a1 choices (most at D2 when a1 led to S2); raised after a2->S1; effects roughly double in the last ~25 trials
